scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && cargo test && npm run test:service-worker && npm run test:build-identity
scripts.lint: npx tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test:service-worker: BUILD_SHA=regression-cache-key npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const worker=fs.readFileSync('dist/sw.js','utf8'); if (!worker.includes(\"rrl-shell-regression-cache-key\") || worker.includes('__BUILD_SHA__')) process.exitCode=1;"
scripts.test:build-identity: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const docker=fs.readFileSync('Dockerfile','utf8'); const required=['ARG BUILD_SHA=dev','ENV BUILD_SHA=\${BUILD_SHA}']; if (docker.includes('unidentified') || !required.every(value => docker.includes(value)) || docker.split(required[1]).length - 1 !== 2) throw new Error('Dockerfile must pass BUILD_SHA to both frontend and backend builds');"
